claims.text: DFT-based simulations can optimize phase stability in materials with variable composition and microstructure.
DFT-based simulations can refine material microstructure.
DFT-based simulations can enhance material properties.
DFT can be combined with ab initio or molecular-dynamics simulations for simultaneous optimization.
There is a lack of an effective method for simultaneous optimization of phase stability, microstructure, and properties.
DFT-based simulations can predict and optimize material properties concurrently.
Electronic structure and interatomic interactions mediate the proposed optimization.
Electronic structure and interatomic interactions enable precise prediction of phase stability.
Electronic structure and interatomic interactions enable prediction of microstructure refinement and property enhancement.
Simulation-driven analysis can identify an optimal composition and microstructure.
The identified composition and microstructure produce enhanced phase stability, refined microstructure, and improved properties.
The intervention will improve phase stability by 20% relative to trial-and-error approaches, as measured by reduced phase impurities.
The intervention will refine microstructure by 15% relative to trial-and-error approaches.
Microstructure refinement will be indicated by increased grain size and reduced defect density.
The intervention will enhance material properties by 10% relative to trial-and-error approaches.
Property enhancement will be indicated by increases in strength, toughness, and conductivity.
The accuracy of DFT-based simulations depends on the exchange-correlation functional, basis set, and other computational parameters.
The hypothesis is falsified if at least two of the three improvement metrics are less than 5% relative to trial-and-error optimization.

contradictions.description: The intervention is computational prediction and optimization, but the outcome is phrased as direct physical refinement and property improvement without specifying the synthesis or processing step that implements the simulated optimum.

Microstructure 'refinement' is operationalized partly as increased grain size, whereas grain refinement ordinarily denotes decreased grain size; the proposed metric is therefore internally misaligned with the named outcome.
